Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the tracing overview and the dashboards looked really promising for our SRE and platform teams. Before we commit to a pilot, our procurement team asked for a clearer breakdown of the observability add-ons: specifically retention tiers (30/90/365 days), the tracing events/retention pricing model, and how advanced dashboards are licensed (per-seat vs. per-dashboard).

Could you share:
- A short table with list pricing for retention (GB-month or per-GB) and any tiered discounts for annual commitments
- Tracing: cost per million traces or per-event, and whether long-term retention is priced differently
- Advanced dashboards: whether we can buy a block of dashboards or user seats, and pricing for 10 / 25 / 50 seats

Also, if you have a bundled price for all three addons (retention + tracing + dashboards) for an annual commitment of ~$150k ARR, that would help our budget. Procurement is looking at a target start date of May 1.

Appreciate a concise quote we can attach to our internal approval packet.

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Pasted below is a concise breakdown; I attached a PDF with the same numbers and a sample SOW for an annual bundle (observability_pricing_v2.pdf and redwood-addons-sow.xlsx).

Summary list pricing (standard):
- Retention (storage): $0.12 per GB-month (30 days default).
  - 90-day retention add-on: +$0.07 per GB-month incremental.
  - 365-day retention add-on: +$0.18 per GB-month incremental (supports cold-tier retrieval).
- Tracing: $1.50 per million traces ingested, includes 7-day hot retention. Long-term tracing retention billed at $0.09 per million traces-month.
- Advanced Dashboards: $120 per seat/month (includes real-time widgets, cross-run correlation). Alternatively, dashboards can be purchased in bundles: $1,100 per dashboard/year for up to 5 dashboards (saves ~10% vs seats for dashboard-heavy teams).

Bundle guidance for ~$150k ARR target (annual pre-discount):
- Example bundle (annual commit): 30 TB storage-month equivalent with 90-day retention + 25M traces/month + 25 seats = $162,400/yr (base).
- Standard annual commit discount: 15% off list for 12-month prepay.
- Volume discount tiers: 20% for $300k+ ARR committed, 25% considered for strategic pilots tied to reference/customer case studies.

If useful, we can do a tailored quote with your exact usage profile. For May 1 start we’d need signature by Apr 15 to ensure allocation.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share the attached PDF & SOW.
2) If Procurement asks for a concession, loop in Stephanie for pricing approval.
3) We can draft a DocuSign once scope is agreed.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez

- Retention: 30 TB-month effective (90-day retention), Tracing: 25M traces/month baseline with adaptive sampling guidance, Advanced Dashboards: 15 seats + 10 dashboard bundle.
